svg.text: Augusta A to H are the ballroom's eight sections, 127 x 104 ft together in the chart: A to D along the north side, west to east, and E to H

text.font-family: Barlow Semi Condensed, Avenir Next Condensed, Roboto Condensed, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: along the south, east to west, with a corridor inside the ballroom between the two rows

text.font-family: Barlow Semi Condensed, Avenir Next Condensed, Roboto Condensed, system-ui, sans-serif
Barlow Semi Condensed, Avenir Next Condensed, Roboto Condensed, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: the chart makes A and H, at the west end, 44 ft wide and 29 and 27 deep, and the other six about 28 wide and 44 or 45 deep. The plan draws A

text.font-family: Barlow Semi Condensed, Avenir Next Condensed, Roboto Condensed, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: so, on the corridor, with rest rooms behind it. It draws H 32 ft deep over the western 35 ft of its width, an office behind it, and as deep

text.font-family: Barlow Semi Condensed, Avenir Next Condensed, Roboto Condensed, system-ui, sans-serif

svg.text: as its row over the 9 ft at its east end; the hotel's current plan draws the same. H is drawn at the chart's 27 ft, on the corridor
